purpose: Local deterministic sustainability responses and simple guided conversations before falling back to RAG/Gemini.

fallback.note: If no local intent/flow matches, send the query to the existing RAG pipeline.

intents.start_response: I can give you a quick water-saving plan. First, how long is your usual shower or bath?

intents.answer: Start by separating recyclable, organic, and residual waste. Avoid single-use items where practical and reuse containers before disposing of them.

quests.title: Sort today's household waste
quests.description: Separate recyclable, organic, and residual waste for one day.

intents.answer: Turn off unused lights and devices, avoid leaving chargers plugged in unnecessarily, and use efficient lighting and appliances when available.

quests.title: Switch off unused devices
quests.description: Check one room and switch off lights or devices that are not being used.

intents.answer: For short trips, walking or cycling can reduce emissions. For longer trips, public transport or sharing rides can reduce the number of vehicles used.

quests.title: Choose a lower-carbon trip
quests.description: Replace one short vehicle trip with walking, cycling, public transport, or a shared ride.

intents.answer: Protect existing trees and green spaces first. Where planting is appropriate, choose locally suitable species and make sure there is a plan to care for them after planting.

quests.title: Care for a local green space
quests.description: Spend a short session watering, cleaning, or caring for a tree or nearby green space.

intents.answer: Choose a small local action that other people can verify, such as joining a cleanup, reporting a local environmental issue, or helping confirm a community report.

quests.title: Take one verified community action
quests.description: Join a local cleanup, report an environmental issue, or help verify an existing community report.

intents.answer: SDG 11 is Sustainable Cities and Communities. It focuses on making human settlements inclusive, safe, resilient, and sustainable.
SDG 12 is Responsible Consumption and Production. It focuses on using resources more efficiently, reducing waste, and improving how goods are produced and consumed.
SDG 13 is Climate Action. It calls for urgent action to address climate change and strengthen resilience to climate-related impacts.

steps.question: About how many minutes is your usual shower or bath?
Do you currently know of any leaking taps, pipes, or toilets at home?
Do you usually run the washing machine only when you have a full load?

recommendation_rules.recommendation: Try reducing your shower by a few minutes and track whether the shorter routine still works for you.

quest.title: Shorten your shower
quest.description: Reduce your usual shower time for the next 3 days.

recommendation_rules.recommendation: Prioritize checking and fixing the known leak because continuous leaks can waste water over time.

quest.title: Inspect the known leak
quest.description: Check the leaking tap, pipe, or toilet and arrange a repair if needed.

recommendation_rules.recommendation: Do a quick leak check around taps, toilets, and visible pipes.

quest.title: Do a household leak check
quest.description: Inspect taps, toilets, and visible pipes for signs of leakage.

recommendation_rules.recommendation: When practical, wait for a fuller laundry load instead of running many small loads.

quest.title: Run one full laundry load
quest.description: Wait until you have a reasonably full load before using the washing machine.

water_personalization.default_recommendation: Your habits already avoid several common sources of unnecessary household water use. Keep monitoring for leaks and avoid using more water than needed.
